$comment: The exact list of known defects the expected-failure tests assert against (plan 3.3 principle 7, plan 4.2). A case is listed only while the defect is present on this branch and a test asserts it. The test named in asserted_by passes while the defect is present and fails the moment it is fixed (or a new one of the same kind appears), so a fix removes its entry in the same change. The list must be empty at release (definition of done 6). Main-owned; tests/census/known-defects.test.ts checks the shape below.

shape.title: the defect in one sentence
shape.where: the file, tool or handler that carries it (repository-relative paths, no machine paths)
shape.found_by: the plan, decision or recon reference that named it
shape.evidence: what a reader can re-run or re-read to see it, with the measured source named
shape.asserted_by: { file, test, case? }: a test file that exists and holds an it or test whose literal title equals `test` exactly. For a parametrised test (it.each with a title such as "$id") `test` is that title and `case` names the one case: a string literal that the file holds. The test that asserts the entry also names the entry back (KD-nnn titles in tests/census/known-defects.test.ts, the switch in the flag test)
shape.fixed_by: the work item or unknown that fixes it (U1, kernel 3.1, W1, Phase 1 item 1 and so on)
shape.switch: CLI-flag entries only: the switch with its leading dash
shape.files: CLI-flag entries only: every repository file whose code holds the defective occurrence of the switch (a literal passed to Workbench, or for the dedicated server's switches to ArmaReforgerServer.exe); the flag test fails when a file is added or removed
shape.defect_kind: CLI-flag entries only: unknown-switch (no measured source knows it) or misused-switch (a measured source knows the name but documents another meaning)

defects.title: The S-A headless script passes -wbProjectPath on purpose, which is not a Workbench parameter
defects.where: scripts/live/s-a-headless.ts (S-A-1, the U1 measurement of the old arguments, never run); the three headless tools were fixed by DEC-048 package B and pass -gproj
defects.evidence: The switch has no cli-switch row in E05 (the Workbench executable's switch table) or in E08 (Bohemia's Page_CLI). The recon found it absent from the executable in ASCII and UTF-16 and from all 274 cached documentation pages; wb_launch passes the real flag, -gproj. Verdicts from these tools may describe the project the launcher preselected, not the requested one. The S-A session script passes it on purpose in step S-A-1, the U1 measurement of the old arguments, only with the EMCP2_decoy precondition (DEC-029).

asserted_by.test: passes only switches a measured source knows, apart from the listed defects
